lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Did he say, w-what did he say while he was shooting her? Or just before he shot her?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That we had to hurry up before he had some people coming over.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Was the car still out front?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK, we're gonna take ya where Mark just took ya and we know there's some, some things that you're, you're not tellin' us. We need to get the accuracy about the garage and stuff like that and the car.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: How does the car get in the garage?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: After he puts her on the fire or before?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK, so lets go back to outside, you carry her over, she's naked, right? (Brendan nods “yes”) And you put her on the fire?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And what do you do when she's on the fire?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: We threw some tires on top of her and some branches.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: You threw tires and branches on her (Brendan nods “yes”), and then what?
